abstract_cn:
手语是听障人士的母语，是其认知与表达的自然载体。对于以手语为第一语言的使用者而言，键盘输入需经历手语思维到汉语语法再到文字编码的双重转换，认知负荷高且表达效率低。针对上述问题，本文设计并实现了一套基于MediaPipe的轻量化多模态实时手语识别系统，以双手组合编码为核心交互范式，在普通RGB摄像头和CPU环境下实现从连续手势到自然中文语句的完整转换。系统以医院导诊为验证场景，提供手语翻译与AI智能导诊两种工作模式。

系统采用七层流水线架构。感知层使用MediaPipe HandLandmarker提取21点手部关键点坐标，输入降采样至128px以平衡精度与速度。特征提取层集成三个互补编码器：SpatialGCN（图卷积网络，0.15M参数）编码手部骨骼空间拓扑，LightweightVisualEncoder（MobileNetV3-Small骨干，冻结）提取ROI视觉纹理，MotionEncoder（0.04M）融合关键点速度场与运动学特征，包括Wagh et al. (2025)验证为临床级的手掌速度和BVE轨迹稳定性指标。三模态通过CrossModalFusion（2层Transformer Encoder，1.9M）融合为256维统一表示。时序建模层采用SlowFast TCN（双路径时序卷积，0.7M），通过时间均值池化与交叉熵损失实现序列级分类。DL管线总可训练参数量3.4M，远低于任务书10M上限。规则识别层基于手指关节角度（165度伸直阈值）和手掌朝向的几何判定树，实现15种手势的确定性分类。引入PIP关节误差补偿，以更可靠的MCP关节辅助校验，满足可解释AI（XAI）框架。语义解析层采用左手模式加右手内容的双手组合编码，左手持7种模式手势（数字/身体/医院/病症/程度/时间/常用语），右手做10种内容手势，组合覆盖70个基础语义槽位。SentenceRecorder状态机管理句子级录制流程，TemporalSemanticParser通过最长后缀匹配解析语义链。模式切换自动插入分隔符。LLM增强层接入DeepSeek API进行语义重组与自然语言润色，导诊模式下实现多轮症状追问与科室推荐。UI展示层采用Vue3单页应用+FastAPI WebSocket后端，支持DL/规则双模式一键切换。

实验基于1,311条混合样本（351条真人含ROI+960条合成含域随机化）训练多模态模型50轮，验证准确率达90.6%，测试准确率82.8%。消融实验表明GCN贡献76.6个百分点，运动编码器贡献31.6个百分点，视觉编码器贡献9.6个百分点，验证了多模态设计的有效性。规则引擎在合成验证集上达到Macro F1=97.6%，但在真人测试集上仅为31.1%，揭示了硬编码阈值在真实场景中的局限性。DL模型通过从数据学习用户特化特征，将测试准确率提升了51.7个百分点。系统检测速度31.7FPS，满足任务书25FPS要求，端到端处理延迟32.1ms。
abstract_en:
Sign language is the primary communication modality for over 70 million deaf individuals worldwide and serves as the natural vehicle for their cognition and expression. For native sign language users, typing requires a cognitively demanding double conversion process: from sign language concepts to Chinese grammatical structures, and then from Chinese grammar to character-level encoding. This thesis presents a lightweight, multimodal real-time sign language recognition system centered on the MediaPipe visual pipeline. The system adopts a dual-hand combinatorial encoding protocol as its core interaction paradigm, achieving complete conversion from continuous gestures to natural Chinese sentences using only a commodity RGB camera and CPU. A hospital triage scenario serves as the proof-of-concept, supporting both sign language translation and AI-assisted triage consultation modes.

The system employs a seven-module layered architecture. The perception layer uses MediaPipe HandLandmarker for 21-point hand keypoint detection with input downscaled to 128 pixels. The feature extraction layer integrates three complementary encoders: SpatialGCN (0.15M) for skeletal topology, LightweightVisualEncoder (MobileNetV3-Small, frozen) for ROI texture, and MotionEncoder (0.04M) with 17 kinematic features validated by Wagh et al. (2025). Three modalities are fused through CrossModalFusion (1.9M) into a 256-dimensional representation. The SlowFast TCN (0.7M) with temporal mean pooling and cross-entropy loss performs sequence classification. Total trainable DL parameters: 3.4M. The rule-based layer uses finger joint angles (165-degree threshold) with PIP/MCP dual-channel verification for XAI. The semantic layer introduces dual-hand combinatorial encoding: left hand holds 7 mode gestures, right hand executes 10 content gestures, yielding 70 semantic slots managed by SentenceRecorder state machine. The LLM layer accesses DeepSeek API for polishing and triage. The UI uses Vue3 with FastAPI WebSocket.

Experiments on 1,311 samples (351 real + 960 synthetic) achieved 90.6% validation and 82.8% test accuracy. Ablation quantified modality contributions: GCN 76.6pp, motion 31.6pp, visual 9.6pp. Rule engine achieved 97.6% F1 on synthetic but only 31.1% on real data; DL improved by 51.7pp. Detection speed: 31.7 FPS, exceeding the 25 FPS requirement, with 32.1ms processing latency.
